gloss: even if; even though; no matter (how, what)

definitions.explanation: Attached to the て-form: the result in the main clause holds despite the condition. It covers both a supposition (even if it rains) and a fact (even though I took medicine).
With a question word or いくら, どんなに: whatever the case, the result is the same.

examples.english: I'll go even if it rains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がらない→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I've taken medicine, my fever won't go down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧ても、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よければ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいる。
examples.english: Even if it's a little expensive, some people will buy it if the quality is good.
Whatever you say, it's no use.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ても⟦{太|ふと}らない→太る：01190_futoru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't put on weight.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ても、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how busy I am, I make a point of walking for thirty minutes every morning.

notes:
FORMS:
- Verbs: て-form + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — ⟦{行|い}っ→行く：00119_iku⟧ても, ⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ after a voiced て-form)
- i-adjectives: ~くても — ⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧ても
- na-adjectives and nouns: ~⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧
- Casual speech: ~たって — ⟦{行|い}っ→行く：00119_iku⟧たって

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ~ても⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: may, it's all right to
- ~⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ても⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: don't have to
- ~ても~⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ても: whether or not
- いくら / ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ~ても: no matter how

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: even though — only for facts, and carries surprise or complaint; ても also covers suppositions
